text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide conquered the Satsuki Sho. 
However, she felt an unsettling 
contradiction in her "theories."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin's sheer obsession with 
victory. She sensed something in it that 
couldn't be quantified by any formula.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Another formidable rival, Winning Ticket, 
also fires up her fighting spirit, 
declaring the "Japanese Derby" an 
unyielding dream.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A rematch against her generation rivals at 
the Tokyo Yushun (Japanese Derby). Will 
she be able to wipe away the anxiety that 
arose even after winning before that day 
arrives...?
